sections.title: Send your first file
sections.body: Verify your account email, upload a file, and add the recipient’s verified Fyde email or phone. Type Send my résumé to John. Fyde delivers to their Received page by default. Choose email or phone for a download link, or save a different default in Settings.

sections.title: Choose what can be shared
sections.body: Standing permissions cover the selected version, contact, purpose, and expiry. They exclude future versions. Sensitive files need explicit permission. You can pause sharing or revoke a link at any time.

sections.title: Read the receipt
sections.body: Available in app means the recipient’s verified account can download the file from Received. External notification status is separate: provider acceptance does not prove delivery. A failed notification does not remove an app delivery. Download started records verified access; downloaded copies cannot be recalled.

sections.title: Let a contact request documents
sections.body: Create a standing permission for an exact version, contact endpoint, delivery channel, purpose and expiry. Share the request link. The contact signs in to a matching verified account or verifies the permitted email or phone before requesting. Out-of-scope items stay private.

sections.title: Understand send limits
sections.body: One file version made available to one verified recipient in Fyde, or accepted by an external delivery provider, counts as one send. Both events together count once. Downloads, searches and rejected requests do not add sends. Storage, file size and bandwidth have separate limits.
